global_sequence_description: Surveillance footage of a grocery aisle where a synthetic subject takes a boxed product and swiftly conceals it inside their jacket.

chronological_sequence_segments.scene_description: The subject stands in the center of the aisle wearing an unzipped jacket, holding a small blue-and-white product box in their right hand while looking directly forward.
The subject uses their left hand to pull open the left side of their jacket, while simultaneously sliding their right hand inside to deposit the box into the interior pocket.
The subject pulls their empty right hand out, lets the jacket fall closed naturally over the concealed item, and stands with their hands resting near their waist.
